title.zh: SmartLingo Guru 常见问题图标修正

purpose.zh: 修正 Guru 常见问题按钮双重图标，并把旧职业英语与人才库问题换成 Flash／Max 学习引导。
purpose.en: Correct the double icon on Guru's FAQ button and replace legacy career-English and talent questions with Flash/Max learning guidance.

zh: Guru 常见问题按钮只显示居中的列表图标，保留原有无障碍名称与问题菜单；问题内容改为适合语言新人的 Flash／Max 引导。
Flash、Max 和 Guru 新入口及支付、会员数据均保持上一成功发布版本。
en: Show only the centered list glyph on Guru's FAQ button while preserving accessibility; make the suggested questions relevant to new Flash/Max learners.
Leave the Flash, Max and Guru entry flow, payment and membership data from the previous successful release unchanged.

zh: 仅 Guru 常见问题按钮样式、引导问题和回归测试；不改变支付价格或数据库结构。
en: Only the Guru FAQ button style, suggested questions and regression test; no price or database-schema changes.

zh: 用不可见的旧字符占位和绝对居中的列表图标避免两个符号同时出现，交互逻辑不变。
en: Hide the old visual character and center the list glyph without changing FAQ behavior.

zh: 构建、零警告 lint、TypeScript、全量测试与图标回归检查通过；WebKit 与生产浏览器在部署时重新核验。
en: Build, zero-warning lint, TypeScript, full tests and the icon regression check passed; WebKit and production browser are reverified during release.

zh: 普通会员的线上登录态验收仍需专用 QA 会话；本次不产生真实付款或开启直播。
en: Real signed-in ordinary-member production acceptance still requires a dedicated QA session; no real payment or live broadcast was initiated.

zh: 保留上一版本的十二种界面语言、Flash／Max 入口和既有教室权限。
en: Preserve the previous release's twelve interface languages, Flash/Max entries and existing room permissions.

rollback.zh: 无需数据回退；若需撤销图标修正，重新部署上一成功提交即可。
rollback.en: No data rollback is required; redeploy the previous successful commit to revert the icon correction.
